- [ASSISTANT_SAID] During World War II, Sibelius faced criticism for not opposing Finland's alliance with Nazi Germany and was seen as co-opted by the ruling political establishment.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Despite criticisms, Sibelius remained a beloved figure in Finland until his death in 1957, and his music is celebrated for its nationalistic spirit and depictions of the Finnish landscape and people.
